userStories.title: Provider delta boundaries and loop missing-output attempt rotation
userStories.description: As an operator reading a workflow run room, I want Devin and DeepSeek ACP text chunks persisted with their provider-known delta semantics and each structured-output re-ask isolated in its own transcript attempt, so that one streamed answer renders as one assistant block instead of many rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Devin event-bridge tests assert every text-valued agent_message_chunk maps to a MessageChunk with textMode: 'delta' (thought chunks, tool events, replay suppression, usage unchanged); they fail before the production change and pass after.
DeepSeek event-bridge tests assert the same delta contract with the same RED-then-GREEN evidence.

Each provider's acp-client test sends two separate message chunks (e.g. 'Hel'/'lo') through the fake ACP child process and asserts two ordered delta chunks concatenating to 'Hello' followed by the unchanged terminal result.
Loaded-session replay still suppresses replayed messages and the first new message is a delta.
dag-executor tests prove direct and loop persisted chunks carry metadata.text_mode: 'delta'.

dag-executor tests prove invalid-output AND missing-output loop re-asks each produce a distinct transcript attempt (newTranscriptAttempt called in the missing-output branch near packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts:6660 before the next provider pass, mirroring the existing rotation at ~line 6630).
No new state, stream identifier, database field, provider buffering, or UI heuristic introduced; historical rows without text_mode untouched.

Focused suites pass: (cd packages/providers && bun test src/community/devin/event-bridge.test.ts src/community/devin/acp-client.test.ts src/community/deepseek/event-bridge.test.ts src/community/deepseek/acp-client.test.ts); (cd packages/workflows && bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts); (cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/project-text-transcript.test.ts src/lib/agent-history.test.ts).
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 1 of the plan (phase-01-start.md). Production edits are exactly two: add textMode: 'delta' to the assistant-object returns in mapDevinSessionUpdate() (packages/providers/src/community/devin/event-bridge.ts) and mapDeepseekSessionUpdate() (packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/event-bridge.ts); call newTranscriptAttempt(executionScope-equivalent) in the loop missing structured-output re-ask branch of packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts (~line 6660). Do NOT extract a shared ACP mapper. Tests-before: tighten exact bridge object assertions, extend fake ACP processes to emit split chunks, add executor persistence + re-ask-isolation assertions; record failures before implementing.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 1 (commit 0a42a072). Files: packages/providers/src/community/devin/event-bridge.ts, packages/providers/src/community/deepseek/event-bridge.ts, packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts + their test files. RED→GREEN evidence recorded; providers 78/78, workflows 629/629, web 35/35 focused tests pass; eslint/prettier/tsc clean.

userStories.title: Canonical spec reconciliation and one-string unwrap transform in buildAgentHistory()
userStories.description: As an operator viewing a structured report node, I want an exact schema-declared one-string JSON envelope rendered as its Markdown string value while every ambiguous payload stays byte-for-byte visible, so that transcripts are readable without ever losing audit data.
acceptanceCriteria: _bmad-output/specs/spec-agent-node-room/SPEC.md is updated BEFORE code changes to state the resolved rule: tool payloads keep their explicit Raw affordance, exact one-string envelopes show their string value, assistant text that cannot be losslessly classified fails closed to original text; the three production surfaces are named. If this spec change cannot be made, the story stops — no alternate fallback is invented.

AgentHistoryInput accepts optional outputFormat?: Record<string, unknown>; the transform runs after projectTextTranscript() independently per projected text item, and tool rows remain boundaries between blocks.

A block unwraps only when ALL guards pass: schema is a non-array record with type === 'object'; properties is a non-array record with exactly one own key; that property is a non-array record with type === 'string' (annotations/constraints allowed); the whole text parses to a non-null non-array object with exactly that key and a string value; rawText === JSON.stringify(parsed).

Every failed guard or parse error returns the original string byte-for-byte: missing/absent schema, non-object schema, zero/multiple properties, non-string property type, malformed/fenced/prose-wrapped/array/primitive/null payloads, missing/extra keys, non-string values, duplicate keys, whitespace or escaping variation, reordered keys.
Text assembled from compatible deltas into an exact payload unwraps once after assembly; matching intermediate blocks separated by tool rows unwrap independently without joining across the tool.
Input rows are never mutated; item IDs, sequence, execution identity, occurrence, attempt, timestamps, tool items, and status are preserved; only qualifying text is copied.
dag-executor test proves the engine contract independently: a structured node result remains a { report: string } object and a downstream $producer.output.report reference receives the string.
Focused suites pass: (cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/agent-history.test.ts src/lib/project-text-transcript.test.ts); (cd packages/workflows && bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts).
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 2 core (phase-02-structured-transcript-presentation.md, requirements + decision matrix + security sections). Production change confined to packages/web/src/lib/agent-history.ts: optional input field plus a small local helper using own-key checks, explicit non-null/non-array checks, JSON.parse in try/catch, canonical-equality enforcement, and copy-on-qualify mapping. No mount wiring in this story (US-003). No evaluation, JSON repair, raw HTML, or custom sanitizer. Tests-before: unit cases exposing today's raw-wrapper output for an exact one-string schema, the full decision matrix, delta-before-unwrap ordering, per-block behavior, byte preservation, and input immutability.

userStories.title: Wire outputFormat through three transcript mounts with deterministic real-server E2E
userStories.description: As an operator using Legacy, the Console selected room, or Console inline history, I want each mount to pass the matched definition node's output_format into the shared projector, so that the readable one-string presentation and fail-closed fallback behave identically everywhere — proven against the real server, API, definition, and built Web bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: LegacyNodeRoom forwards definitionNode?.output_format through NodeTranscriptPane into buildAgentHistory(); component test proves schema forwarding, readable Markdown render, and fail-closed fallback.
ConsoleNodeRoom supplies the selected definition schema; component test proves parity.

ConsoleInspectPane resolves nested definition nodes (reusing its existing resolver — no second recursive walker) and forwards each schema into inline ConsoleExecutionHistory; component tests prove forwarding and parity, including nested loop-group nodes.
While a definition is missing/loading/deleted, original history renders and rerenders when the definition resolves; transcript is never hidden and node output is never guessed.
e2e/fixtures/workflows/e2e-transcript-display.yaml exists: deterministic bash anchor plus conditionally skipped exact/fallback report nodes declaring the one-string schema; no AI call occurs.

e2e/lib/playwright/archon-runtime.ts gains ONE narrow prepareTranscriptDisplayRun()-style helper that runs the fixture and seeds exact fragments, ineligible fallback rows (malformed, extra-key, multi-field, schema-less, duplicate-key, noncanonical-escape), execution metadata, and lifecycle events into the isolated SQLite DB; no generic DB-seeding API exposed; fake provider structuredOutput capability unchanged.

e2e/ui/workflow-transcript-display.spec.ts proves on the isolated real server: matching report shows only the string value with existing assistant label/Markdown/link behavior in all three mounts (inline history checked before room selection); ineligible rows remain byte-for-byte visible; node-message API rows retain exact seeded fragments, order, and execution metadata (only the projected Web block is unwrapped).
Persisted rows, API output, Markdown components, raw-HTML policy, engine structured result, and downstream $node.output.field behavior unchanged; no JSON-specific React component added.

Focused verification passes: (cd packages/web && NODE_ENV=development bun test src/components/workflows/LegacyNodeRoom.test.tsx src/components/workflows/NodeTranscriptPane.test.tsx src/experiments/console/components/ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx src/experiments/console/components/ConsoleInspectPane.test.tsx src/experiments/console/components/inspect/ConsoleExecutionHistory.test.tsx); bun run build:web; (cd e2e && npm run typecheck && npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts ui/workflow-transcript-display.spec.ts --grep 'transcript-display.structured').
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 2 wiring/E2E half (phase-02-structured-transcript-presentation.md, Architecture + Files + Tests Before 4-6 + Implementation steps 5-8). Files: LegacyNodeRoom.tsx, NodeTranscriptPane.tsx, ConsoleNodeRoom.tsx, ConsoleInspectPane.tsx, inspect/ConsoleExecutionHistory.tsx, e2e fixture/spec/archon-runtime.ts. Run bun install first — DOM suites need the locked happy-dom dev dependency. The browser spec must accurately label seeded boundaries (seeded data does not prove provider streaming). Keep the exhaustive malformed matrix in unit tests; browser fallback proof uses the prepared ineligible rows.

userStories.title: Legacy viewport containment, hidden-label geometry, and runtime minimap removal
userStories.description: As an operator on a long Legacy run, I want the run shell fixed to the viewport while the transcript scrolls internally and the runtime graph keeps every interaction except the unneeded minimap, so that no blank region appears and all controls remain reachable.
acceptanceCriteria: RED evidence recaptured first: current source reproduces root scroll height far above client height and escaped window.scrollY via failing browser assertions (saved prior-session measurements are not accepted as proof).

NodeRoom.tsx adds relative to the direct tool-row summary and ConsoleAgentHistoryList.tsx applies the same fix; every direct sr-only status label's bounding box lies within its summary box and its accessible text remains (component + browser assertions).

LegacyGraphLogsPane.tsx adds min-h-0 overflow-hidden to the right resizable run panel; NodeTranscriptPane.tsx adds overscroll-y-contain to [data-testid='node-transcript-scroll'], which remains the body's sole vertical scroll owner.

document.scrollingElement.scrollTop === 0 with the pointer over the transcript, room header, or non-node graph area; root scroll height ≤ client height + 2px at both 1440x1000 and 390x844; transcript tail becomes reachable and transcript-at-bottom wheel input moves neither root scroll nor stable headers.

Room header, occurrence navigator, jump control, todo strip, Ask cards, queue composer, resize handle, and other state-specific controls remain present; Tab/Shift+Tab order, visible focus, keyboard transcript scrolling, Ask/composer reachability, and focus restoration pass at both viewports; no horizontal document overflow.

WorkflowDagViewer.tsx removes MiniMap plus only the imports/constants dead because of it (ExecutionNodeData, status-color data); controls, pan, zoom, fit, layout, focus, and node selection still work, verified by transform/selection/room-state observation — not element presence alone.
WorkflowCanvas.tsx and BuilderCanvas.tsx are untouched and their minimaps remain; RunGraphPanel.tsx unchanged as the Console parity regression.

Layout.tsx is modified ONLY if post-fix browser metrics still prove an ancestor defect, and then with the smallest missing min-h-0/containment rule plus a passing route sweep across Legacy Chat, Dashboard, Workflows, Builder, and Settings; no global body rule and no duplicated overflow-hidden on Layout.main.

e2e/ui/workflow-run-hitl-room.spec.ts gains separate desktop and narrow long-history cases (established extended-timeout class, polling for deterministic row load and geometry, no sleeps) covering geometry, pointer-exit wheel, hidden labels, tail, and keyboard; e2e/ui/workflow-transcript-display.spec.ts gains the runtime-graph absence + retained-interaction + builder-minimap-presence assertions using the US-003 fixture.

Focused verification passes: (cd packages/web && NODE_ENV=development bun test src/components/workflows/NodeRoom.test.tsx src/components/workflows/NodeTranscriptPane.test.tsx src/components/workflows/LegacyGraphLogsPane.test.tsx src/components/workflows/WorkflowExecution.test.tsx src/experiments/console/components/ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx src/experiments/console/console-isolation.test.ts); bun run build:web; (cd e2e && npm run typecheck && npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts ui/workflow-run-hitl-room.spec.ts --grep 'transcript-display.legacy-scroll'); (cd e2e && npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts ui/workflow-transcript-display.spec.ts --grep 'transcript-display.graph').
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 3 fix half (phase-03-legacy-run-viewport-regression-coverage.md, Proven cause and repair order + Browser scenario matrix). Exactly three local CSS fixes plus one minimap deletion; native CSS only — no wheel listeners. Add stable verification tags only after each browser test has deterministic setup/assertions (tag→scenario mapping lands in US-005). Do not start duplicate dev servers; reuse the runtime harness and stop owned processes.

userStories.title: Governed verification registration, fresh verification attempt, and full regression gate
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the new functional and visual behaviors registered in the verify-archon system and proven by a fresh governed attempt plus the full validation suite, so that the delivered states are durably enforced rather than checked once.
acceptanceCriteria: .agents/skills/verify-archon/lib/browser-scenarios.ts maps the new ui.transcript-display scenario to exactly [V:transcript-display.structured], [V:transcript-display.legacy-scroll-desktop], [V:transcript-display.legacy-scroll-narrow], and [V:transcript-display.graph].

.agents/skills/verify-archon/features/run-ui.json registers matching behavior/scenario obligations; ui.visual stays mapped to [V:verify.visual-captures] and its visual-<digest> runner ID is regenerated after visual-config.json changes so a stale binding fails selection.

.agents/skills/verify-archon/visual-config.json adds assistant-report and runtime-graph states for both surfaces at desktop and narrow viewports, and the canonical spec hash is refreshed to match the US-002 SPEC.md update.

.agents/skills/verify-archon/lib/visual-review.ts and e2e/ui/verifier-visual.spec.ts record the actual run ID per visual case (HITL captures and the prepared transcript-display captures come from different real runs) and drive/capture the new configured states — a tag mapping alone is not accepted as visual proof.

A fresh governed functional and visual verification attempt runs against a clean committed implementation target and retains its desktop and narrow artifacts; ordinary Playwright output is not labeled governed proof.
bun x tsc --noEmit -p .agents/skills/verify-archon/tsconfig.json and bun run test:verification-skills pass.
bun run validate passes in full (focused suites, package-isolated tests, build/type/lint/format) with no weakened assertions; existing Legacy/Console isolation tests stay green.
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 3 governance half (phase-03-legacy-run-viewport-regression-coverage.md, Verification registration + Implementation steps 9-10 + Regression gate). This story only wires verification metadata/drivers and runs gates — all product code lands in US-001..US-004. If any product gap surfaces while registering proof, fix it minimally and note it, do not skip the registration. Commit the implementation before the governed attempt as the verifier requires a clean committed target.
